taste.name: Serif Voice, Sans Tools
taste.trigger: When selling clinical software to solo therapists and clinic owners who distrust enterprise tooling
taste.decision: Chose a warm serif (fields, 66.6px/500) for every headline and Proxima Nova only for UI and body over one sans family across the whole page
taste.reason: A practitioner reading 'Your patients have you, your practice has Jane' hears a person, not a vendor; the sans stays for scanning labels and forms where a serif would slow them down

taste.name: One Teal, Tinted Surfaces
taste.trigger: When needing hierarchy and section separation without borders, shadows or multiple hues
taste.decision: Chose a single teal hue at four lightness steps (#EAFAFB, #CDF5F7, #027989, #025968) for all surfaces and actions over a multi-color palette with neutral gray panels
taste.reason: Each tint reads as a different section while the brand stays one color; a clinic owner skimming the page always knows teal means 'act here'
evidence: text #04070A and #54575A, no second accent hue

taste.name: No Shadows, Rounded Plates
taste.trigger: When grouping testimonials, features and the newsletter form into containers
taste.decision: Chose flat tinted plates with 16px radius and 8px controls, zero box-shadows, over elevated shadowed cards
taste.reason: Depth would add visual noise on top of a busy product screenshot hero; fill color alone separates blocks and keeps the page light on slow clinic desktops
evidence: radius set 8px (26 uses), 16px (5 uses), 50% (play button, avatars)
testimonial plate #CDF5F7 beside photo plate, no borders

taste.name: Product Screenshot As Hero
taste.trigger: When the first viewport must prove the software is usable by non-technical staff
taste.decision: Chose a full-width real scheduling UI mock (1280px, 16:9) under the headline, with two CTAs only (filled 'Sign up', outlined 'Explore plans and pricing'), over abstract illustration or a stock-photo hero
taste.reason: Practitioners buy what they can picture themselves clicking; showing the calendar, appointment panel and chat bubble answers 'what does a day look like' before any feature list
evidence: CTA pair at y~458 within first 900px
